loo_error_pct.note: too few points for meaningful cross-validation

osi_note: OSI is calibrated on 3 full transient (pulsatile) OpenFOAM solves, not on the steady sweep. Sac OSI and sac TAWSS co-vary, so a power law in TAWSS reproduces all of them to within 4.8%. This is an empirical relation over a narrow geometry family, fitted to few points — treat it as indicative, and confirm with a transient solve before relying on it. Note: PT-2026-0101, synthetic01 averaged over less than 75% of the cycle.
